summary: runc fails container initialization in its seccomp setup path because probing the SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_WAIT_KILLABLE_RECV capability returns EINVAL and runc 1.5.0 treats that unsupported-flag result as fatal. The error is propagated through OCI runtime create and containerd RunPodSandbox, so control-plane sandboxes cannot start. The merged fix makes the wait-kill capability probe tolerate EINVAL as an unsupported feature instead of aborting container creation.
